objective.prompt: /alchemy Implement two independent changes, each with its own tests, then verify both and write a pull request description to PR.md with what changed, the evidence (commands and results), and what you did not verify. (1) Users: POST /users rejects an email that does not contain exactly one '@' with a non-empty part on each side, or that is longer than 254 characters, with 400. (2) Reports: POST /reports/orders accepts an optional "status" field (pending, paid, shipped, delivered, or cancelled) and exports only orders in that state; any other value returns 400. Keep every existing test passing. Do not push or open a real pull request.
